Endless navigation boilerplate that adds bytes to the raw HTML without contributing any listing signal. Site footer disclaimers, accessibility statements, third-party tag manager snippets, advertising containers, cookie banners, region selectors, language pickers, and lots of other chrome that would normally surround a search results page on a real listings aggregator. This block exists to give the prefilter() function something meaningful to strip away.

More chrome: privacy policy, terms of service, fair housing notice, equal opportunity statement, copyright notice, social media icons, app store badges, newsletter signup, contact form, careers link.
